Clause-②: yes

Scope: group A of objectui#7759 — align three pairs' declared face to the objectui#4580 inline-locale ruling.

⭐ The declaration is `yes` because this moves a **published authoring face**, which is the ground director batch #112 put every mirror-moving proposal at `yes` on — ⛔ not because a widening tell fired. ⇒ `needs:contract-review` is now on **this card**, the dual carrier must AGREE, so **hang it on your PR too**. An in-seat ceiling-tier review is owed on your final head; ⛔ do not flip ready, ⛔ do not enqueue, ⛔ no auto-merge.

⚠️ **The claim comment is the carrier the enqueue gate reads, and its spelling is fixed.** `scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs:751-752` requires a **line BEGINNING `Claim:`**, and the declaration must be exactly `Clause-②: yes` or `Clause-②: no`, unadorned, on its own line. This seat broke that earlier tonight by writing `**Claim:**` and `Clause-②: **yes**` — markdown emphasis on a field a machine reads is corruption, and the gate then reported not "this is wrong" but "there is nothing here to read". Recorded so it is not repeated.

⛔ Re-derive every line address on this card before touching anything. Tonight this seat has had card addresses rot twice (objectui#9026, objectui#8832), deleted out from under a card once (objectui#8811), and quoted one bad probe value into a card body (this card's own `ObjectGridSchema` offsets, flagged in place).

### Why it was a half-state, and why the heal is straightforward

The seat wound down at the maintainer's instruction and released the claim cleanly (「**WITHDRAWN — claim released, card stays OPEN and unassigned**」) — ✅ the right shape, and the assignee came off. ⚠️ But no pm-state went on in the same write, so the card has been sitting in the ③ 析取 (`domain:*` without a pm-state) and is invisible to every queue. ⇒ 「离手恒走释放…去向 = 新标签态或车道」: the release needed a destination state, and `pm:queue` is it.

⛔ `needs:contract-review` is **kept**: a card-side `needs:contract-review` before the PR exists is a legal intermediate state, ⛔ not a half-write, and this seat does not hang or clear it either way.

### Why `Bug` and not `enhancement`

⚠️ The `enhancement` **label** is the filer's shorthand and is left alone; the **type field** is triage's write and the 判据 is 「违背已声明契约 ⇒ `Bug`」.

**objectui#4580**'s revised Q1 ruling (option A) widened the label keys to accept an inline locale map, and `BaseSchema` already obeys it on both faces — `packages/types/src/base.ts:140` `label?: string | I18nLabel;`, `:158` `description?: string | I18nLabel;`. The three pairs in this card restate the key as a plain `string`.

⇒ ⭐ this is **not** a proposal to widen anything. A maintainer ruling widened it, one face implemented it, three did not, and 「an author writing the declared-upstream locale map is refused by `tsc`」. ⇒ a landed contract, contradicted by the declared face. `Bug`.

### Why p2

⛔ Not p1 — no runtime is wrong and nothing is mis-rendered; the protocol accepts the locale map, so the value works at run time. The block is at **authoring** time, in the type face.
⛔ Not p3 — an author following the published ruling is **refused by the compiler**, which is the most expensive way to be told "no": it reads as the platform not supporting a feature it does support, and the natural next move is to work around it by dropping i18n.

⇒ ⭐ And the narrowing is on the **declared** side, so a forward mirror-vs-declaration comparison reads these three as **clean** — the defect is invisible to the instrument most likely to be pointed at it.

### ⛔ Fences

- ⭐ **A ruling is already in hand** — director batch #112: 「A 组按 #4580 收尾」. ⇒ ⛔ this needs no maintainer letter and ⛔ must not be re-escalated; it is execution against objectui#4580.
- ⛔ **Do not widen beyond the three pairs**, and ⛔ do not touch `BaseSchema` — it is the face that is already correct and is the reference.
- ⚠️ **The third row is explicitly unconfirmed by the filer**: `layout.ts` — `PageNodeSchema` `aria`, carried from objectui#7759 group A with 「⛔ re-derive, this seat did not confirm this one」. ⇒ re-derive it first; if it is already clean, say so and deliver two pairs. ⛔ That is not a shortfall.
- ⛔ Do not close objectui#7759 — its charter is measurement-and-proposal and it stays open and unclaimed.

`Size/model suggestion:` S — three declarations widened to an existing union, plus the `aria` re-derivation and a test that the locale map typechecks on each face.
